iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 70. STABLE: Islamabad talks collapsed over 20-year vs 5-year enrichment freeze. US delegation heading to Pakistan Tuesday for second round. Iran denies plan to transfer enriched uranium to US. Polymarket: 41.5% enrichment deal by Apr 30. IAEA locked out 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. IAEA DG Grossi urges strict verification. CNN: US/Israel targeting Iran nuclear scientists before deal. Probability 36%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 70. STABLE-ELEVATED: IRGC fired on tanker Apr 18, Strait of Hormuz FULLY CLOSED. Ceasefire expires Apr 22 in 3 DAYS. Iran parliament speaker: "far from final agreement." Trump: US delegation heading to Pakistan for second round talks, Tehran delegation arriving Tuesday. Iran deputy FM: no date for face-to-face talks until framework agreed. Trump threatens to "blow up whole country" if deal fails. Oil ~$97. Probability 48%. Stable-elevated.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 70. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire mostly holding, expires Apr 26. Trump invites Israel & Lebanon leaders to White House - first high-level talks since 1983. Hezbollah NOT part of deal - remains armed, demands no Israeli freedom of movement. Israeli drone killed 1 in south Lebanon. Hormuz closure complicates dynamics. Probability 17%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened Europe largest warhead plant (Lalahan), fuel plant, missile integration facilities Apr 7. Largest defense investment in Republic history ($3B). TAYFUN Block-4 hypersonic entering mass production. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned 2026. Defense spending $27.34B. Probability 6%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 - Tier II risk. India summoned Iran ambassador after Indian vessel attacked in Hormuz. First India-Pakistan drone war in May 2025 (Operation Sindoor). India rejected US mediation claims. PM Sharif in Qatar mediating. Probability 7%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 72. RISING: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting expected. First of 64 F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Finnish professor warns Finland could be first target in NATO-Russia war. Denmark intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Russia reinforcing nuclear/Arctic assets. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 29%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: CBS reports China weighing supplying Iran advanced radar - major escalation if confirmed. China says military activities around Taiwan reasonable and justified. Philippines opened coast guard base on Thitu Island - China fired flares at Philippine aircraft. ISW/AEI: PRC infiltration into Taiwan documented. Taiwan opposition parties blocking critical defense system procurement. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun. US redeploying assets from Pacific to Middle East benefits China. Probability 40%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 68. RISING: Launched multiple ballistic missiles toward sea Apr 18 from Sinpo area - 7th test of 2026. Kim oversaw 3-day weapons test series Apr 6-8 including cluster-bomb warheads, 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer, ICBM engine test. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. Polymarket tracking missile test by Apr 30. Probability 11%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1173+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded across Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa, Dnipro. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - Baltic ports Primorsk (40% storage lost), Ust-Luga (30%), Crimea Feodosia destroyed. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones. Ukraine-Germany joint production agreements expanding. Polymarket ceasefire by Apr 30: 0.4%. Probability 30%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: "Open war" continues - Pakistan bombed major cities including Kabul. China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues. Border clashes ongoing. Pakistan declares open war on Taliban regime. CSIS: crisis drifting from resolution. Probability 5%. Stable.
